Contract

Uniqueness — unique up to earned gauge, or RESPONSE_NONUNIQUE?

Legal GREEN outcomes include failure: RESPONSE_NOT_FORCED, RESPONSE_NONUNIQUE. Banned: fitting curvature to get a source; putting a Bell comparator into the law; importing Hilbert, CMI, or site dictionaries; a STATUS bump. Only if both forced and unique may a later step coarse-grain toward the connection/holonomy already recognized on the v15.45 operator. That would still not be Einstein.
